name: Vicky's Investigation
source:
Vicky suspects her dad is cheating on her mom, but she needs evidence before she can confront him. Dad is out and his laptop is on his bed. This is her chance! But Vicky gets distracted by the gorgeous porn saved on her dad's computer. Gorgeous porn that she can't help but touch herself to. 

Distractions can lead to mission failure.  Dad returns and catches his daughter in the act. Vicky is in a whole heap of trouble! But she has ways of making it up to daddy...

[From Itch.io]
